page_title: LEV 4-2 OVI | Levante v Oviedo 21/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+3' 4 - 2 Goal! Ivan Romero (Levante) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 4:2.
90+2' Levante have been awarded a corner kick.
90' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Oriol Rey goes off the pitch and Ugo Raghouber (Levante) comes on.
89' A substitution has been made. Jon Ander Olasagasti goes off and Kervin Arriaga (Levante) comes on.
84' Nacho Vidal will be replaced by Pablo Agudin (Real Oviedo).
84' Luis Castro has decided to substitute Victor Garcia and he is replaced by Tai Abed (Levante).
83' Great teamplay by Oviedo as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alberto Reina leaves the pitch and Alex Fores (Real Oviedo) comes on.
79' Levante are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.

77' Victor Garcia (Levante) expertly wins the ball from the free kick, but his effort from the edge of the penalty area isn't accurate at all and the ball goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Oviedo.
76' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Santi Cazorla (Real Oviedo) was quite harsh and Jesus Manzano didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
75' Carlos Espi (Levante) is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Ivan Romero.
75' Substitution. Kareem Tunde leaves the pitch and is replaced by Fran Cortes (Levante).
74' The foul by Oriol Rey (Levante) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Jesus Manzano.
73' The current number of offsides is 1:0.
72' The attendance is 19398.
71' Today's referee Jesus Manzano rightly decides to book Kareem Tunde (Levante) for his harsh tackle.
70' Jorge Guillermo Almada Alves decides to make a substitution. Kwasi Sibo will be replaced by Santiago Colombatto (Real Oviedo).
68' Half-chance! Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) plays a pass into the box, but Mathew Ryan reacts well to snuff out the attack.
64' Here comes a substitution. Santi Cazorla (Real Oviedo) is brought on as a substitute for Nicolas Fonseca.
64' The substitution is prepared. Haissem Hassan (Real Oviedo) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Thiago Fernandez.
64' Jorge Guillermo Almada Alves prepares a substitution. Javi Lopez is replaced by Rahim Alhassane (Real Oviedo).
61' Iker Losada (Levante) looks very unsteady on his feet after that head injury. Safety first, so he’s coming off and Luis Castro has decided that Pablo Martinez Andres is the man to take his place.
59' Iker Losada (Levante) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
58' Oviedo take a short corner kick.
56' Referee Jesus Manzano halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Jorge Guillermo Almada Alves, then shows him a yellow.

52' 3 - 2 Goal! Kareem Tunde finds Iker Losada (Levante) with a clever pass. He steps inside his man on the edge of the box and whips a tremendous shot into the bottom right corner. Fantasy football! 3:2.
49' Oviedo enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
46' Levante seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+7' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+6' Jesus Manzano rightly pulls out a yellow card and shows it to Alberto Reina (Real Oviedo).
45+3' 2 - 2 Goal! Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) puts the ball into the middle of the goal past the outstretched arm of Mathew Ryan.
45+3' Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) is going to take the penalty!
45+2' Levante concede a free kick following a bad challenge. It's a penalty to Oviedo! Let's see who's going to take it.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.

44' 2 - 1 It's a goal! Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) makes it 2:1. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Javi Lopez and planted his close-range header into the top of the net. Mathew Ryan was helpless.
42' Carlos Espi (Levante) spurns a great opportunity from inside the 6-yard box. The ball flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Oviedo.
41' Neat passing move from Oviedo in order to create new attacking opportunities.
39' Jon Ander Olasagasti (Levante) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
38' Eric Bailly (Real Oviedo) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Jesus Manzano didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
35' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
33' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 3:5.
33' The Levante players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
31' Crossbar! Nacho Vidal (Real Oviedo) throws the chance away as he attempts to produce a shot from inside the box, but his attempt only rattles the crossbar! The goalkeeper can remain calm.
28' The Oviedo players are exchanging some short passes.
25' 2 - 0 Goal! Carlos Espi (Levante) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot inside the right post. He makes it 2:0.
24' Jon Ander Olasagasti (Levante) takes the corner which is cleared.
23' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) goes close to scoring with a shot from inside the box, but he drags his effort wide of the right post.
22' Eric Bailly (Real Oviedo) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
21' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
21' Victor Garcia (Levante) gets to the rebound inside the box and shoots to the middle of the goal, but his sidefooter is blocked by an alert Aaron Escandell. What a save!
19' Kareem Tunde (Levante) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
18' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 3:1.
16' It looks like Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) saw red with that tackle. Jesus Manzano won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
15' One of the Levante players commits a holding foul and the referee reaches for his whistle.
13' Oviedo control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
11' The ball is cleared after Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
9' Jon Ander Olasagasti (Levante) expertly controls a neat clever pass inside the box, but his effort crashes against the crossbar! What an opportunity that was!

9' What a poor attempt! Iker Losada (Levante) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands. The ball goes out of play and Oviedo will have a goal kick.
8' Levante force a corner. They send men into the box.

4' 1 - 0 What a beautiful moment! Carlos Espi (Levante) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way inside the right post. Aaron Escandell just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 1:0.
4' The Levante players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
2' Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) sprays a pass out to Ilyas Chaira, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.
2' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Levante.
1' The match has just started.
Levante will kick-off.
Jesus Manzano is introduced as the referee for today's match.
